'''Graffiti Square''' was a plaza in [[Black Sun territory]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Located in the territory of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate, the square was controlled by the gang, and had fallen into disrepair by [[3643 BBY]]. Despite the gang presence and the general downtrodden feeling in the area, the [[Silent Sun cantina]] continued to draw patrons from both citizens and criminals.

==Behind the scenes==
Graffiti Square is a subzone of the Black Sun Territory map on Coruscant in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and features many Black Sun members as enemies. The area is also notable for containing one of the game's [[datacron]]s: namely, Datacron 04: King [[Adas]], a green Endurance datacron, located on one of the upper terraces of the area.
